name: Dia
tagline: An AI-native web browser with chat and skills built into the URL bar.
description: An AI-native desktop web browser from The Browser Company, the team behind Arc. Dia bakes a chat assistant and reusable 'skills' directly into the address bar, with awareness of your open tabs and browsing history, so you never need to copy context into a separate chatbot. It launched publicly on macOS in 2025. A free tier covers light AI use; a $20/month Pro plan removes the AI usage limits.
edge: From the makers of Arc; AI lives in the address bar aware of your open tabs and history, not a bolted-on chatbot.
pros: AI baked into the URL bar
cons: Pro at $20/mo to lift AI limits
